blocks.title: Jadeed periodic law
blocks.text: Anasir ki tabee aur kimiyai khusoosiyat un ke atomic numbers ke periodic functions hain.

Atomic number atom mein protons ki tadaad hai. Yeh qanoon periodic table ka sang-e-bunyad hai: milti-julti khusoosiyat wale anasir khaas waqfon par aate hain. Jab anasir barhte atomic number se tarteeb diye jayen to sodium, potassium aur cesium lithium jaisi bohat si tabee aur kimiyai khusoosiyat dikhate hain, kyunke yeh sab ek hi group mein aate hain. Magar chunke nucleus mein protons ki tadaad batadreej barhti aur naye electron shells jurte hain, anasir ki tabee aur kimiyai khusoosiyat ek group aur ek period ke andar ba-qaida tareeqe se badalti hain. Agle topics in khusoosiyat ko ek ek kar ke lete hain: atomic radius, ionic radius, ionization energy, electron affinity, electronegativity aur dhaati kirdar (metallic character).

blocks.prompt: Sodium, potassium aur cesium lithium se kyun milte hain, phir bhi us se napi jane wali baaton mein mukhtalif hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh lithium se is liye milte hain ke atomic numbers ke silsile mein yeh usi waqfe par, usi group mein usi valence electron ke saath aate hain. Mukhtalif is liye hain ke har ek mein zyada protons aur ek izafi shell hai, to jasamat, ionization energy aur reactivity jaisi khusoosiyat group mein neeche ba-qaida badalti hain.

items: Jadeed periodic law: khusoosiyat atomic number ke periodic functions hain; milti-julti khusoosiyat wale anasir waqfon par, ek hi group mein, dobara aate hain.
Protons aur shells ke jurne se khusoosiyat group aur period ke andar phir bhi ba-qaida badalti hain; rujhan moassar nuclear charge aur andarooni shells ki tadaad se tai hote hain.
